b.heading: How MikroORM Detects Changes
b.quote:
Whenever you fetch an object from the database MikroORM will keep a copy of all the properties and associations inside the `UnitOfWork`.

Now whenever you call `em.flush()` MikroORM will iterate over all entities you previously marked for persisting via `em.persist()`.
b.statement: Whenever you fetch an object from the database MikroORM will keep a copy of all the properties and associations inside the `UnitOfWork`. Now whenever you call `em.flush()` MikroORM will iterate over all entities you previously marked for persisting via `em.persist()`.

b.heading: Transaction Demarcation > Transaction Propagation
b.quote:
| Propagation        | Description                                                                      |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `NESTED` (default) | Creates savepoint if transaction exists, otherwise new transaction               |
| `REQUIRED`         | Uses existing transaction if available (no savepoint), otherwise creates new one |
| `REQUIRES_NEW`     | Always creates independent transaction, suspending existing one                  |
| `SUPPORTS`         | Uses existing transaction if available, otherwise executes non-transactionally   |
| `MANDATORY`        | Requires existing transaction, throws error if none exists                       |
| `NOT_SUPPORTED`    | Suspends existing transaction and executes without transaction                   |
| `NEVER`            | Must execute without transaction, throws error if one exists                     |
